title: 接触触发尺度生长｜小型陪伴物入介质后长成巨体
source_title: 玩具入水巨龙化｜触水触发尺度升级
summary: 先建立明确成年人、小型非人陪伴物和可测量环境尺度；陪伴物接触介质后，涟漪、体积和水体位移连续升级，原身份特征保留，最终由同框巨体完成尺度证明。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original person, one small nonhuman companion and measurable environment scale. + Use one visible contact with a declared medium as the sole transformation trigger. + Keep recognizable companion features and displaced medium continuously visible during growth. + Make environment reaction scale with body growth while preserving the adult's position and geography. + End with the same adult and transformed companion in one readable frame that proves final scale.
recommended_input: 黎明原创浅盐池旁，一名明确成年北非植物学家穿赭色野外外套，手里托着掌心大小的黄铜种子机器，带三片蓝色叶翼。；三片叶翼和中央黄铜核心保持可见，身体在透明水下扩大；盐粒与水从原接触点连续向外位移。；拉成广角并停住，明确成年植物学家与完整变形生物同框，掌心装置身份仍可辨，不加文字和品牌。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original person, one small nonhuman companion and measurable environment scale.
Use one visible contact with a declared medium as the sole transformation trigger.
Make environment reaction scale with body growth while preserving the adult's position and geography.
End with the same adult and transformed companion in one readable frame that proves final scale.
